Definition: feminine from G3101; a female pupil:--disciple.
BiblicalUsage: The word is the feminine of disciple, and it is used once, for Tabitha at Joppa, a disciple full of good works and almsdeeds. When she died, the widows showed Peter the coats and garments she had made, and Peter prayed and raised her.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Tabitha is the proof that a disciple is measured by a life of quiet good works, and that God notices the coats sewn for widows as surely as any sermon.
